title: Photo required: what it does not apply to, and unusual cases
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with "Settings - Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  2. Templates with the photo option on and off, plus a pre-release template; photo upload that can be made unavailable; you are filling inspections against them.
custom_steps:
1. With the option off, mark Not OK with no photo and Submit.
  2. Mark OK, Monitor, N/A and Submit.
  3. Attach a photo then change the response to OK; then satisfy the rule, remove the photo, and try to Submit.
  4. Turn the option on mid-inspection; make photo upload unavailable.
  5. On an unlabelled field read the outstanding row; upload a rejected format.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With the option off, a Not OK response with no photo submits successfully.
  • OK, Monitor and N/A never require a photo (Monitor requires a note, not a photograph).
  • Templates created before this release are unaffected until an author opens one and turns the option on.
  • A photo attached then abandoned (response changed to OK) is kept; satisfying the rule then removing the photo blocks submit again.
  • Turning the option on mid-inspection leaves that inspection on the rule it started with.
  • If photo upload is unavailable to the shop, the technician is told why rather than blocked with no visible cause.
  • An unlabelled field is identified in the outstanding-items list by its type and position.
  • A photo rejected for its format is met with a message naming the accepted formats at the point of failure, not a generic upload error.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9440 (S17 — Require a photo on a Not OK response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S17; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S17-N1: “If the option is off, a Not OK response with no photo will submit successfully”
  • S17-N2: “OK, Monitor and N/A never require a photo. Monitor requires a note, not a photograph”
  • S17-N3: “Templates created before this release are unaffected until an author opens one and turns the option on”
  • S17-E1: “If the technician attaches a photo and then changes the response to OK, the photo is kept”
  • S17-E2: “If the technician satisfies the rule and then removes the photo, the field blocks submit again”
  • S17-E3: “If the option is turned on while an inspection is already in progress, that inspection keeps the rule it started with”
  • S17-E4: “If photo upload is unavailable to the shop, the technician is told why rather than being blocked by a requirement with no visible cause”
  • S17-E5: “If the field has no label, the outstanding-items list identifies it by its type and position rather than showing an empty row”
  • S17-E6: “If a photograph is rejected for its format, the technician is told which formats are accepted at the point of failure rather than being left with a generic upload error”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
